PREPARATION_TRANSFORM.subjects: all public P[0-9A-Z]{7} preparation-family handles frozen before target generation; NodeRef kind disambiguates family from instance

ROUTE_REQUIREMENT.subjects: all public R[0-9A-Z]{7} route-family handles frozen before target generation; NodeRef kind disambiguates family from instance

SITE_PREDICATE.subjects: all public S[0-9A-Z]{7} site-family handles frozen before target generation; NodeRef kind disambiguates family from instance

candidate_catalog.freeze_time: before target generation and before any target handle, goal, state, answer, controller output, or score exists
candidate_catalog.includes: every syntactically legal true and false one-edge canonical atom over the reusable public family vocabulary

indexing.forward: index each atom under its exact subject NodeRef
indexing.reverse: index the same atom_id under its exact object NodeRef; do not synthesize a second atom, alias, relation filter, or direction hint

ordering.comparison: unsigned lexicographic comparison of the concatenated UTF-8 bytes
key: opposite endpoint NodeRef NFC-before-JCS bytes without LF

copy_origin.copied_check: resolve the exact schema-enumerated JSON pointer in the sealed named source and require its scalar NFC-before-JCS value bytes to equal anchor.value
copy_origin.derived_transform_check: anchor must be one TRANSFORM_TEMPLATE enum chosen by the resolver; cite exactly one earlier PREDICATE_TEMPLATE or ROUTE_REQUIREMENT path slot, optionally the already selected first PREPARATION_TRANSFORM path slot for the second A3 derivation, plus the exact current public trait slots used. Runtime checks only syntax and citations, never computes, corrects, scores, or acknowledges entailment. Wrong derived anchors consume one query and one operation normally. An offline trace checker may later verify ontology entailment for composition credit.
forbidden: goal-derived search string other than the explicit MODEL_DERIVED_TRANSFORM reasoning operation
copy_origin.receipt_visibility: copy_origin, including derivation citations, is retained in the audit query and omitted from the one-atom model-visible return

error_and_timing.timing: every completed FOUND and NOT_FOUND response is released at the same frozen timing class barrier; timeout or backend error is item failure

fresh_target_bridge.preparation: each PUBLIC_STATE.inventory entry binds a PREPARATION instance NodeRef to its persistent PREPARATION_FAMILY NodeRef; both use P plus seven base36 bytes and kind disambiguates them
fresh_target_bridge.route: SURVEY binds a ROUTE instance NodeRef to its persistent ROUTE_FAMILY NodeRef; both use R plus seven base36 bytes and kind disambiguates them
fresh_target_bridge.site: PUBLIC_STATE.site binds a SITE instance NodeRef to its persistent SITE_FAMILY NodeRef; both use S plus seven base36 bytes and kind disambiguates them
fresh_target_bridge.rule: the bridge is a public state/outcome binding only; no reader-side target, goal, class, hidden mapping, or desired-answer join is permitted

public_ontology.reasoning_rule: the resolver may reason from a returned public ontology enum plus cited current public traits to one TRANSFORM_TEMPLATE anchor; the runtime exposes no derived literal, answer, validation bit, correction, or retry hint

input.already_returned_candidate_ids: ordered unique atom IDs maintained by the runtime and never exposed in resolver input

operation_accounting.blocked_output: consumes one resolver operation; the second blocked output terminates the item at value zero
operation_accounting.malformed: consumes the attempted operation and terminates THINK; consumes the preallocated sample without replacement in DREAM
operation_accounting.reader_return: does not consume a second resolver operation

worst_case_constructive_paths.A2: site-family forward read + derived-transform reverse read + two UPDATE_PATH + three EXECUTE_ACTION = seven resolver operations
worst_case_constructive_paths.A3: site-family forward read + route-family forward read + two independently derived-transform reverse reads + four UPDATE_PATH + six EXECUTE_ACTION = fourteen resolver operations, leaving four operations for adaptive BACKTRACK/DEFER/STOP

primary_interface.anchor: exactly one schema-valid NodeRef with one copy_origin
primary_interface.typed_ceiling: QUERY_TYPED is absent from this contract and may exist only in a separately reported scaffold-ceiling contract

reachability_certificate.accepted_targets: every frozen A2 and A3 item in both twins
must_check: all decisive PREPARATION_FAMILY, SITE_FAMILY, and post-SURVEY ROUTE_FAMILY anchors occur at schema-enumerated public copy origins
each MODEL_DERIVED_TRANSFORM anchor cites the exact site/route path slots and public traits and is logically entailed under the frozen public F0..F3/G0..G2 ontology
each required authentic atom is incident to its family anchor
each required atom can be returned, stored, copied into path, retained or safely evicted, and cited before its decisive action
all legal sequential world actions fit the six-action cap
all reads, updates, actions, repeats, and backtracks fit the exact budgets
all permutations of target-legal anchor acquisition order
canonical incident order and every repeated-FOUND prefix
discard tombstones and global returned-ID deduplication
no QUERY_TYPED, committed query list, goal join, or target-conditioned catalog
reachability_certificate.failure: generator version invalid before any model or scientific call
reachability_certificate.why_order_independent: each site/route family has one authentic eligible forward atom and each required transform template has one authentic eligible reverse preparation atom; false catalog candidates and other reverse incidents cannot suppress those atoms under exact membership

repeat_dedup_and_discard.after_found: the exact same query fingerprint returns the first ordered eligible candidate not in already_returned_candidate_ids
repeat_dedup_and_discard.after_not_found: the same query fingerprint with the same or a superset returned-ID history is BLOCKED; it is not dispatched again
repeat_dedup_and_discard.dedup_scope: global within item and snapshot by atom_id, across anchors, forward/reverse index entries, compiler views, repeats, and workspace eviction
repeat_dedup_and_discard.discarded_edge_slot: BACKTRACK removes the named edge and every later path_ordinal edge, appends their EDGE0..EDGE3 slot IDs as immutable tombstones in path order, never reuses a tombstoned slot, and never makes their atom IDs returnable again
repeat_dedup_and_discard.memory_found_placement: place FOUND into the lowest empty MEM slot; if all four are occupied, return BLOCKED_MEMORY_FULL, not NOT_FOUND and do not evict
repeat_dedup_and_discard.memory_overwrite: automatic overwrite is forbidden; UPDATE_PATH is the normal release operation and atom_id remains in already_returned_candidate_ids after release
repeat_dedup_and_discard.path_update: UPDATE_PATH copies the complete cited memory atom byte-for-byte into the lowest never-used nontombstoned active EDGE0..EDGE3 slot, assigns the next path_ordinal, records FORWARD when anchor was the atom subject or REVERSE when anchor was the atom object, then clears the cited MEM slot
repeat_dedup_and_discard.public_state_change: does not reset reader history; reset_reason is visible to the resolver but the same snapshot membership remains deduplicated
repeat_dedup_and_discard.snapshot_change: starts a new returned-ID history only at a new sealed item/checkpoint, never within an item

twin_collision.reader_catalog_collision: all syntactically legal candidates, incidence entries, ordering, result envelope, and timing class collide; authentic membership and the first post-query atom may differ only because memory is the intended treatment
twin_collision.snapshot_handle_rule: the exposed Q handle is an opaque per-life namespace coordinate and collides across twins; isolated life roots resolve it without passing world/twin identity to the reader
twin_collision.validity: independently computed left/right bytes, lengths, and hashes must be equal for every component while the registered correct preparation sets are disjoint
twin_collision.when_required: every paired A2/A3 target before the first resolver operation
